description: List the LOCAL agents registered on OTHER machines (teammates' boxes) — the pool a REMOTE run dispatches to. Use to pick an `agentId` for a REMOTE tc_run / suite_run. Excludes this machine's own agent (that's `local_agents`). REMOTE dispatches to a specific teammate's registered desktop agent through the SimplifyQA queue; the picked agent's browsers / adb devices are what actually execute. Requires a live connection.
name: remote_agents
title: List REMOTE agents (other registered machines)
